label: v225
changes: Birthdays now actually appear on the calendar. Until now the month grid only showed events you had filed yourself — so nobody's birthday, name day or anniversary was ever on it. They now show as a small ring on the day, and tapping the day lists them with the age or the number of years.
Extended family & friends' birthdays appear there too — the gap Rory reported.
New legend entries for Birthday, Name day and Anniversary, so the new markers are explained. Hollow ring means the calendar worked it out from a record; a solid dot is still an event you filed.
A day with one thing on it now reads "1 item" instead of "1 items".
